designationHistory.indexText: Two Rivers National Wildlife Refuge was originally established in 1946 as part of the Upper Mississippi River National Wildlife and Fish Refuge to protect and enhance habitat for migratory birds.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Two Rivers National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

FWS Two Rivers NWR history page (archived 2008): divisions "were established in the 1940's and early 1950's"; consolidated as the Brussels District of Mark Twain NWR in 1958; renamed Two Rivers NWR in 2000
